purpose: Attack the highest-leverage reasons Prometeo is still only parallel rather than self-compounding: strategic self-critique, context retrieval, planner regeneration, historical coverage and unattended event-loop design.
priority_basis: Current throughput snapshot identifies automatic work regeneration as primary bottleneck. Priorities now put recursive Planner and Context Fabric implementation ahead of lower-leverage prose/spec work while preserving a fresh strategic critic and event-loop design in the first parallel wave.
claim_protocol: Use the same exclusive create-if-absent claim root as Q-CANARY-SWARM-01: coordination/opportunities/claims/<opportunity_id>.json. Never overwrite a claim. Losing a race means reload all active canary queues and choose another compatible READY opportunity.
run_protocol: Persist STARTED before substantive work, write only isolated own claim/run/return artifacts, then RETURN and DONE. Shared architecture/authority heads are off-limits.

opportunities.mission: Design the shortest operational path from current manually seeded queues to recursive Planner -> Queue -> Workers -> Returns -> Steward -> Planner. Define exactly how returns, proposals, incidents, blockers and strategy-critic findings compile into generation N+1 without human batch design. Include dedup, dependency DAG, risk/critic insertion, stop conditions and evidence of compounding across two generations.
opportunities.write_scope: claim + own run + own return only
acceptance_criteria: generation N inputs and N+1 output schema are explicit
a minimal two-generation canary path is specified
human does not design generation N+1
opportunities.return_contract: Executable two-generation planner-loop contract and minimal canary path, not just prose architecture.
